description: Fix timezone handling bugs in a Python scheduling application. The workspace at /home/ga/workspace/scheduler_app/ contains two files with timezone bugs: scheduler.py and models.py. Both files use naive datetime.now() calls which cause incorrect time displays for users in different timezones. Your task: (1) Add 'from datetime import timezone' import to scheduler.py (and models.py if needed), (2) Replace all datetime.now() calls with datetime.now(timezone.utc) in the following functions: create_appointment, get_upcoming_appointments, and save_appointment. You need to fix at least 3 instances total across both files. Use Find in Files (Ctrl+Shift+F) to locate all datetime.now() occurrences. After making changes, save all modified files.
